facts.text: I am trying to get a better handle on my spending habits.
I have been tracking my online shopping.
I noticed I have been buying a lot of stuff recently.
I spent around $80 on fruits, veggies, and pantry staples from Instacart around the 10th of last month.
I bought a new pair of Nike sneakers from Amazon a few days after the Instacart order.
I bought beauty and skincare products online.
I did a big haul from Sephora.
I ordered a new book on Audible around the 20th of the previous month.
I ordered a wireless charging pad from Best Buy's website around the same time as my Sephora haul.
The wireless charging pad from Best Buy was on sale for $20.
I am curious about how to keep track of online shopping habits and expenses.
